name: latex-renderer-local
description: Render local LaTeX projects through LaTeX Renderer from Claude Desktop.
long_description: A local stdio MCP server for explicitly selected LaTeX files, directories, and ZIP projects. The server uploads source through the existing sandboxed renderer and downloads artifacts to the local machine.

tools.name: upload_source
tools.description: Prepare one explicitly selected local directory or ZIP as a Source.

tools.name: create_render_job
tools.description: Create one Job from a Source and explicit entrypoint.

tools.name: render_project
tools.description: Render one explicitly selected local project.

tools.name: get_authoring_guide
tools.description: Read the bundled LaTeX authoring guide.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List saved projects on the connected renderer.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read a saved project and its revisions.

tools.name: get_project_revision_jobs
tools.description: Read the render history for a saved revision.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a saved project on the connected renderer.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.description: Change a saved project's display name.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Hide an owned project after confirmation.

tools.name: attach_project_revision
tools.description: Save an uploaded Source as a project revision.

tools.name: render_project_revision
tools.description: Queue a render for an exact saved revision.

tools.name: list_project_revision_files
tools.description: List files in a saved project revision with an explicitly authorized key.

tools.name: get_project_revision_file
tools.description: Read UTF-8 text from a saved project revision with an explicitly authorized key.

tools.name: get_project_draft
tools.description: Read the shared draft's version, settings, and files.

tools.name: get_project_draft_file
tools.description: Read text from a specific shared draft version.

tools.name: open_project_draft
tools.description: Open an existing draft or start from a saved revision.

tools.name: apply_project_changes
tools.description: Apply an explicitly authorized batch of changes to a shared draft.

tools.name: render_project_draft
tools.description: Queue or reuse a PDF preview of a shared draft version with explicit rendering and draft editing permissions.

tools.name: save_project_draft
tools.description: Save the exact shared draft version as a project revision.

tools.name: request_render_quality_report
tools.description: Request inspection of the canonical PDF from a job owned by the key.

tools.name: get_render_quality_report
tools.description: Read the inspection state and report for the canonical PDF.

tools.name: get_render_status
tools.description: Get safe Job status metadata.

tools.name: download_render_artifacts
tools.description: Download artifacts to an explicit local directory.

tools.name: cancel_render
tools.description: Cancel an owned Job after user confirmation.

tools.name: delete_render
tools.description: Delete an owned terminal Job after user confirmation.

tools.name: get_renderer_capabilities
tools.description: Read the renderer engine, runtime, and limits.

tools.name: list_authoring_profiles
tools.description: List verified authoring profiles and their evidence.

tools.name: check_packages
tools.description: Check whether named LaTeX packages are installed.

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search the available LaTeX package inventory.

tools.name: check_fonts
tools.description: Check whether named font families are installed.

tools.name: search_fonts
tools.description: Search the installed font inventory.

tools.name: check_document_requirements
tools.description: Check document requirements against the runtime inventory.

tools.name: probe_document_requirements
tools.description: Queue an isolated synthetic document probe or read its result.

tools.name: retry_render
tools.description: Queue a new Job with the same Source and render settings.

tools.name: retry_svg_render
tools.description: Retry SVG conversion on the same Job and preserve its PDF.

tools.name: get_render_diagnostics
tools.description: Read paged errors and warnings for an owned Job.

tools.name: read_render_log
tools.description: Read an owned compile log by byte offset or line.

tools.name: get_render_preview_crop
tools.description: Request or read an enlarged region of an exact PDF.

tools.name: get_render_preview_sheet
tools.description: Request or read a contact sheet of selected PDF pages.

tools.name: locate_render_source
tools.description: Find candidate TeX source lines or PDF positions using SyncTeX.

tools.name: compare_render_quality
tools.description: Compare recorded inspection observations for two exact PDFs.

tools.name: get_render_manifest
tools.description: Read the input, runtime, and artifact identities of an owned Job.

api_key.title: LaTeX Renderer API key
api_key.description: Rendering key beginning with lrk_. It is injected only into the local MCP server process.
